# Ben Freeborn

> Ben Freeborn works on refugee nutrition, food security in displacement settings, and humanitarian innovation. Founder of From Seed to Shelter; currently working with Taimaka in Gombe State, Nigeria.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://benfreeborn.com/index.html): Overview, key questions, and contact information.
- [Journey](https://benfreeborn.com/journey.html): Chronological history from military service in Singapore to Oxford, Tsinghua, microgreens farming in Samos, and fieldwork in Nigeria.
- [Writing](https://benfreeborn.com/writing.html): Essays, fieldwork extracts, and pilot evaluation reports.
- [Questions](https://benfreeborn.com/questions.html): A running collection of questions grappled with across different life phases.
